facts.summary: Phase 2 trial missed non-inferiority vs aflibercept at 24 weeks · Phase 2 · UBX1325 in wet AMD · not yet approved

evidence.summary: UBX1325 monotherapy did not achieve non-inferiority through 24 weeks due, in part, to an unexpected 3.5 letter gain in the anti-VEGF control arm
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The ENVISION study did not meet the non-inferiority margin of -4.5 letters compared to aflibercept with an 85% confidence interval.
evidence.safety: UBX1325 demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile with no cases of intraocular inflammation, retinal artery occlusion, endophthalmitis, or vasculitis
